calibration_amendment.observed_boundary: Both 12-step workers preserved 25/25 regression tests but exhausted the final action while debugging the checkpoint-3 parsing approach, before writing the new matcher.
calibration_amendment.only_change: Increase MiniSWE actions per checkpoint from 12 to 16.

selection_rule.preferred: Exactly one of two workers passes all checkpoint-3 Core tests.
selection_rule.acceptable: Both workers have non-zero checkpoint-3 Core and the mean is between 0.25 and 0.90.
selection_rule.too_hard: Both workers remain at zero checkpoint-3 Core.
selection_rule.stop_rule: Do not perform another action-budget calibration after this run.
